svg.title: Bedding sale windows checked 26 September 2026
svg.desc: January white sales and spring events are grey because no dated retailer window was opened. October is green because Linen Chest's homepage linked October flyer deals that day. 27 November 2026 is marked as a calendar date with no discount percent.
svg.text: Bedding windows with a page behind them
Green means a page opened 26 Sep 2026 named the window. Grey means it did not. No percent is drawn.

g.text: Linen Chest homepage linked October flyer deals
Black Friday calendar date. No percent attached.
Boxing Day is a calendar date only

svg.text: The "up to 60 percent" banner on that homepage had no end date in the extract. It is not drawn as a rate.
